titre: Expéditions américaines de climatiseurs et de pompes à chaleur
sous_titre: Unités expédiées, cumul de janvier à juillet

2025.texte: Year-to-date shipments of central air conditioners increased +5.2 percent, to 3,063,290 units, compared to 2,911,784 units shipped during the same period in 2025.

2026.texte: The year-to-date total for heat pump shipments increased +5.8 percent, to 2,570,228, compared to 2,428,800 units shipped during the same period in 2025.
